LOAD_LATEST_SAVE.name: Load Latest Save
LOAD_LATEST_SAVE.description: If true (default), the server loads the most recent save in /factorio/saves. Set to false to require an explicit SAVE_NAME.

SAVE_NAME.name: Save Name
SAVE_NAME.description: Specific save to load (without .zip). If empty and LOAD_LATEST_SAVE=true, the most recent save is loaded. If empty and LOAD_LATEST_SAVE=false, the server refuses to start.

GENERATE_NEW_SAVE.name: Generate New Save
GENERATE_NEW_SAVE.description: If true, creates a new save with the name from SAVE_NAME on boot. Requires SAVE_NAME to be set. The new save persists in the volume.

UPDATE_MODS_ON_START.name: Update Mods On Start
UPDATE_MODS_ON_START.description: If true, runs docker-update-mods.sh on every boot to re-download mod versions listed in /factorio/mods/mod-list.json. Set to false to keep mods pinned.
